photos.name: both-pizzas-on-counter
photos.summary: Two finished pepperoni pizzas cooling on the counter — one on a wire rack in the foreground, one on a cutting board behind. Both show golden-brown crusts with melted cheese and pepperoni coverage.

photos.name: pizza-overhead-wire-rack
photos.summary: Overhead view of a finished pepperoni pizza cooling on a wire rack. Cheese is melted and browned with scattered pepperoni across the surface; the crust edge is thin and lightly charred.

photos.name: slice-bottom-char
photos.summary: Underside of a slice held up to show the bottom crust. Leopard-spotted char pattern from baking on steel, with an even golden-brown base and scattered dark blisters.

photos.name: slice-crumb-structure
photos.summary: Blurry close-up of a slice held at an angle to show the interior crumb. Open, airy structure visible in the crust cross-section with irregular holes throughout.

photos.name: slice-droop-flex
photos.summary: A slice held from the crust end, drooping significantly under its own weight. The tip bends downward past vertical, demonstrating the thin, flexible character of the crust.

photos.name: slice-side-profile
photos.summary: Side profile of a slice showing the thin crust edge-on. The crust is notably thin with a slight cornicione rise at the outer edge and minimal puff through the center.

photos.name: slice-top-pepperoni
photos.summary: Top-down view of a pepperoni slice held above a cutting board with remaining slices. Pepperoni is lightly crisped and cupped, cheese melted evenly across the surface.
